# SINGULANCE

> Public research and product information.

Markdown links below contain server-rendered public page text from the same React source as the visual pages. Private workspaces are not included.

## Public reading list
- [SINGULANCE — AI workforce that runs inside memory](https://singulancelabs.com/index.md): Discover HIVEMIND organizational memory, HyperAgents digital teammates and TARA voice agents. Explore SINGULANCE research and AI workforce tools.
- [HIVEMIND — your company brain](https://singulancelabs.com/hivemind/index.md): Explore HIVEMIND company memory, connected apps, evidence-backed answers and persistent AI teammates.
- [TARA — voice with company context](https://singulancelabs.com/tara/index.md): Explore TARA, the voice experience in the HIVEMIND workspace.
- [HyperAgents — your AI teammates](https://singulancelabs.com/hyperagents/index.md): Explore persistent AI teammate rooms, task results, artifacts and Runtime coordination in HIVEMIND.
- [Delete your account](https://singulancelabs.com/account-deletion/index.md): Request deletion of your SINGULANCE account from your profile or contact the privacy team if you cannot sign in.
- [Runtime](https://singulancelabs.com/runtime/index.md): Meet Runtime, your AI Chief of Staff. Connect authorized company signals, confirmed goals and reviewed team work in one continuous thread.
- [Runtime: intelligence with continuity](https://singulancelabs.com/research/runtime/index.md): The design principles behind Runtime: relevant signals, confirmed goals, specialist coordination, review and human control.
- [SINGULANCE Research](https://singulancelabs.com/research/index.md): Explore SINGULANCE research on agent memory, cognitive swarm intelligence and post-quantum cryptography, with published methods and benchmarks.
- [ICARUS — an agent memory filesystem](https://singulancelabs.com/research/icarus/index.md): Explore ICARUS, SINGULANCE’s agent memory filesystem combining vector, entity, temporal and graph retrieval in one file. Read the research and methods.
- [Cognitive Swarm Intelligence](https://singulancelabs.com/research/cognitive-swarm-intelligence/index.md): Read SINGULANCE research on cognitive swarm intelligence: shared organizational memory, coordinated agents and the architecture behind HIVEMIND.
- [Post-Quantum Cryptography](https://singulancelabs.com/research/post-quantum-cryptography/index.md): Explore SINGULANCE’s research on hybrid post-quantum transport, signed memory writes and tamper-evident audit chains for organizational AI systems.
- [HIVEMIND Memory Benchmarks](https://singulancelabs.com/benchmark/index.md): Review HIVEMIND memory retrieval benchmarks, evaluation methods and published results. Explore the evidence behind SINGULANCE’s memory research.
- [Privacy Policy](https://singulancelabs.com/privacy/index.md): Read SINGULANCE’s privacy policy, including information about personal data, connected services, data protection and your privacy rights.
- [Security](https://singulancelabs.com/security/index.md): Learn about SINGULANCE security practices and data protection for organizational memory and AI agents. Review the published security information.
- [Cookie Policy](https://singulancelabs.com/cookies/index.md): Read SINGULANCE’s cookie policy and learn about essential storage, optional analytics and how to manage your privacy and cookie preferences.

## Workspace
- [Open HIVEMIND](https://next.singulancelabs.com/): Brain, HyperAgents and Tara; requires user authorization.
- [MCP setup](https://next.singulancelabs.com/hivemind/app/mcp): authenticated account connection settings.
